verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a `logseq://` protocol for third-party apps to invoke actions, including an x-callback-url quickCapture that can be bookmarked or run from a shell. It also ships an opt-in local HTTP API server: bearer-token auth, CORS, and a POST `/api` endpoint that dispatches any plugin-API method, with worked curl examples. Together these let scripts create content and drive the app from outside. Missing for 10: documented deep links for opening a specific page or block (the protocol evidence shows only quickCapture), and independent hands-on corroboration of the URI scheme or HTTP API.
